title: Gerald Charles
description: Gerald Charles is a luxury watch brand that offers a wide range of high-end timepieces. The website is designed to showcase the brand’s collection and provide visitors with an immersive experience. The site is built using Remix, and Shopify mainly with the new headless solution Hydrogen.

content1.title: A comprehensive overview
content1.subtitle: Luxury and sophistication
content1.label: Elegance
content1.text1: The Gerald Charles website is designed to reflect the brand’s values of luxury and sophistication. The site features a clean and elegant design that highlights the beauty of the watches. The use of high-quality images and videos provides visitors with a comprehensive overview of the collection, allowing them to explore the details of each timepiece.
content1.text2: The website also includes a store locator feature that allows users to find the nearest Gerald Charles boutique. The built-in e-commerce functionality enables visitors to purchase watches directly from the site. The product pages feature a frame-by-frame animation that showcases the intricate details of each watch, providing a unique and engaging experience for users.

title: Courchevel
description: Courchevel is home to some of the most exclusive alpine destinations, offering a unique combination of luxury and adventure. It stands as a beacon of refined mountain living and world-class hospitality. The website is developed using Next.js, styled with Tailwind, and leverages Storyblok as the CMS, with Apidae API integration to provide dynamic, real-time content about the region.

content1.title: A luxurious experience
content1.subtitle: Detailed and immersive
content1.label: Mountain
content1.text1: The Courchevel website is designed to provide visitors with a comprehensive overview of the region’s offerings. The site features detailed information about the various activities, accommodations, and services available in Courchevel. The design is clean and elegant, reflecting the luxury and sophistication of the destination.
content1.text2: The integration of the Apidae API allows for real-time updates on events, weather, and other information relevant to visitors. This ensures that the content is always up-to-date and accurate. The use of Storyblok as the CMS provides the client with full control over the content displayed on the site, allowing for easy updates and modifications as needed.

title: Ex Nihilo Paris
description: Ex Nihilo Paris is a luxury boutique located in the heart of Paris. The website is designed to showcase the different products and services offered by the boutique. The site is built using Remix with Shopify Hydrogen, deployed on Shopify Oxygen for optimal performance and scalability.

content1.title: A comprehensive overview
content1.subtitle: Luxury and sophistication
content1.label: Elegance
content1.text1: The Ex Nihilo Paris website is designed to reflect the brand's values of luxury and sophistication. Built with Remix and Shopify Hydrogen, the platform leverages Oxygen's edge computing capabilities to deliver exceptional performance and a seamless shopping experience. The architecture ensures fast page loads and optimal user experience across all devices.
content1.text2: A comprehensive customer account area has been implemented, providing users with full access to their order history, invoices, and account management features. This personalized space enhances the customer journey by offering transparent access to all purchase-related information, while maintaining the elegant and refined aesthetic that defines the brand.

content2.title: A unique design
content2.subtitle: A taste of Paris
content2.label: Paris
content2.text1: The Ex Nihilo Paris website provides visitors with an authentic representation of Parisian luxury and sophistication. The site features detailed information about the boutique's products and services, as well as insights into the venue itself. The design balances modern functionality with elegant aesthetics, creating an immersive experience that reflects the brand's refined identity.
content2.text2: The combination of Remix, Shopify Hydrogen, and Oxygen creates a robust e-commerce platform that handles complex functionalities while maintaining exceptional performance. The architecture supports the full range of features, from product discovery to order management, ensuring a cohesive and efficient shopping experience.

title: Bertrand Hospitality
description: Bertrand Hospitality now brings together exceptional venues, showcasing unique expertise. It stands as a benchmark for French art de vivre and hospitality. The website is developed using Next.js, styled with Tailwind, and integrates Storyblok as the CMS.

content1.title: A refined presentation
content1.subtitle: Complete freedom
content1.label: Hospitality
content1.text1: The Bertrand Hospitality website delivers an immersive experience, allowing visitors to explore the various venues where they operate. Special attention has been given to micro-interactions to ensure the navigation feels as smooth and intuitive as possible. These subtle design elements enhance the user journey, making the browsing experience seamless and engaging.
content1.text2: he choice of Storyblok as the CMS was perfectly aligned with the client’s needs. It provides full control over the content they wish to display and highlight. The system’s flexibility allows for easy updates and content management. Additionally, the sidebar feature enables users to filter locations based on various criteria entered in the back-office, offering a tailored and efficient search experience.

title: Cloudy Bay
description: Cloudy Bay is an e-commerce website designed in React JS / Gatsby using Drupal as a back-office. This site is produced for a subsidiary of the Moet Hennesy group. You can buy different exceptional wines. It is also possible to book your place for the many events set up by Cloudy Bay, in their 2 different locations. I contributed to the development of this site during my internship at ultranoir with the different devs of the team.

content1.title: Some of the features
content1.subtitle: Many features available
content1.label: Wine
content1.text1: As you browse the site you will be able to discover the different e-retailers / partner stores selling Cloudy Bay wines. It is also possible to follow the Instagram news of this site and choose the different wines according to the year. Another complexity of this site is the fact of dealing with the different markets, while displaying / hiding some elements according to the chosen market.
content1.text2: For those who are hesitant, it is possible to use the Wine Finder (produces one of the developers of ultranoir) which will allow you to choose the ideal wine according to the different criteria you give it. The purchase of wines is not done on the platform, it is connected to WineDirect which will allow you to buy the selected wines.

title: Eclipse
description: Eclipse was born from a design fiction project where we imagined a dystopian future threatened by famine and overpopulation. To remedy this, the state sets up different capsules allowing people wishing to sacrifice themselves to reduce overpopulation and help their loved ones who would receive a sum of money according to the health and age of the person. These different capsules would be placed in various places in the city.

content1.title: A unique design
content1.subtitle: A valued sacrifice
content1.label: Eclipse
content1.text1: At the time of our restitution we wished to put forward the various achievements by setting up an immersive site to the topic of the Eclipse. Through the navigation, on the main page, different explanations of our conception. A booklet is also available to present the different explanatory diagrams of our idea. Detailed darkprints are also present to explain each element, which is in the cabins and their utility. Finally, we have also put forward the interface that the martyr would face if he had to enter the cabin to sacrifice himself.
content1.text2: We have also presented the different 3D models in a classic way through a slider but we wanted to put them in front of us so that they could be visualized as well as possible. The product page presents in an immersive way all the elements of the cabin, be it the exterior, the interior or even our storage logic with the crematorium. Finally, in order not to forget the martyrs and to value them, we imagined a tower of martyrs where all the urns containing the ashes would be deposited, becoming a place of remembrance.

title: Table food Hall
description: Table Food Hall is a food hall located in the heart of Toronto. The website is designed to showcase the different food vendors and provide visitors with information about the venue. The site is built using Nuxt.js, styled with Tailwind CSS, and integrates Dato as the CMS.

content1.title: A culinary experience
content1.subtitle: A taste of Toronto
content1.label: Food
content1.text1: The Table Food Hall website is designed to provide visitors with a taste of Toronto’s culinary scene. The site features information about the different food vendors located in the hall, as well as details about the venue itself. The design is clean and modern, reflecting the vibrant and diverse food offerings available at the food hall.
content1.text2: The integration of Dato CMS allows for easy content management, enabling the client to update the site with new vendors, menus, and events as needed. The site also includes a blog section where visitors can learn more about the food hall and its vendors. The use of Nuxt.js ensures a fast and responsive user experience, making it easy for visitors to navigate the site and find the information they need.
